versions.changelog:
Initial release of Gym Load Planner — weight selection, progression planning, and plate calculation for lifters.

- Estimates true 1RM from reps@weight using Epley and Brzycki formulas, highlighting agreement.
- Builds detailed %-1RM loading tables per training goal: strength, hypertrophy, and endurance.
- Plans progressive overload blocks (linear, double) with automatic deload weeks every 4th week.
- Calculates barbell plate arrangements for any weight, including nearest-loadable warnings.
- Tracks log of estimated 1RM over time and suggests next-session working loads based on progression rules.
